scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.push:staging: npm run build && node scripts/assemble.mjs staging && cd deploy/staging && clasp push --force
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run push:staging && node scripts/deploy.mjs staging
scripts.push:production: npm run build && node scripts/assemble.mjs production && cd deploy/production && clasp push --force
scripts.deploy:production: npm run push:production && node scripts/deploy.mjs production
